principle: Requested change = authorized change. Everything else = protected.
allowed_scope: Smart Board semantic labels, icons, geometry and border treatment
removal of explicitly forbidden Smart Board UI
sidebar destination set, order, semantic keys and hover colors
removal of Smart Mail New badge/item while preserving Smart Mail
runtime acceptance tests required to prove the above
protected_scope: routing behavior except the existing canonical /intelligence/ runtime mapping
external deployment architecture except the canonical 509 runtime lane

labels: HOW TO USE / HOW TO APPLY
boards.layout: one full-width board, with one full-width semantic section per row, vertically stacked; never two boards or tiles

forbidden_ui: What, Why, So What, For You
content_policy: Do not rewrite or summarize Smart Note content. Renderer may relocate existing source text into the canonical visual structure only.
deployment_policy: Only the canonical governed 509 runtime workflow may deploy this public runtime. Any acceptance failure blocks release.
replication_policy: Do not add additional boards until this single canonical board passes full runtime acceptance. Replicate only after explicit acceptance of the one-board reference state.
